components.name: NotFound
components.doc: A 404 page that is pleasant to land on. The picture is built from plain shapes: two fours and a round zero with eyes that follow the pointer, blink, and hop when poked, while small shapes drift around with depth. Below it, a search field filters the suggested pages as you type.
